title: Ownership transfer and several shops per person
decision: A pending ownership transfer is stored in a new table ownership_transfer, one pending offer per shop, expiring after 48 hours; only the named manager may accept or decline; a new function my_memberships lists a person's shops across tenants; the owner's combined totals across shops are deferred
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 14
rationale: BR-22 needs both people to confirm at different times, so the pending state must be stored, and the approved schema has no table for it. 48 hours is long enough to answer and short enough that a forgotten offer lapses
